https://www.instagram.com/residentevil/
https://twitter.com/ResidentEvil
https://www.facebook.com/ResidentEvilMovie
https://www.tiktok.com/@resident.evil.movie

From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
 
From Columbia Pictures and Constantin Film, in association with TriStar Pictures, Resident Evil hits theatres September 18, 2026.

Asad Qizilbash

snippet.title: Clayface | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet the new face of Gotham. #ClayfaceMovie only in theaters October 23.

DC Studios’ “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery.

Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

The film also stars Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan, as well as Nancy Carroll and Joshua James.

James Watkins directs from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, story by Flanagan, based on characters from DC. The film is produced by Matt Reeves, Lynn Harris, James Gunn and Peter Safran, with Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Rafi Crohn and Paul Ritchie executive producing.

Watkins’ creative team includes director of photography Rob Hardy, production designer James Price, editor Jon Harris and costume designer Keith Madden. Music is by Volker Bertelmann.

DC Studios Presents a 6th & Idaho Production, a James Watkins Film, “Clayface.” The film will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures and released only in theaters in North America on October 23, 2026, and internationally beginning 21 October 2026.

snippet.title: Lanterns, Resident Evil, Marvel's Wolverine, & Ebenezer SDCC TRAILER REACTIONS!!
snippet.description:
LANTERNS, MARVEL’S WOLVERINE, RESIDENT EVIL, & EBENEZER TRAILER REACTIONS!!!  With SDCC 2026 Fully underway, we’ve got a fresh crop of San Diego Comic Con Trailers to React to!!

● Build credit fast and get your first month for just a dollar at https://www.getkikoff.com/rejects today. Thanks to Kikoff for sponsoring us!

First up DC’s new Lanterns trailer gives us a deeper look at both the criminal and cosmic stakes as Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler - Friday Night Lights, Godzilla Kong of the Monsters) attempts to train future lantern Jon Stewart (Aaron Pierre - Rebel Ridge, Mufasa: The Lion King) as an even greater threat - the Manhunters - looms its ugly head…  from show runners Damon Lindeloff (Watchmen), Chris Mundy (Ozark), and Tom King (Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow) the cast also includes Nathan Fillion (Superman, Firefly) as Guy Gardner, along with Laura Linney (Ozark), Kelly Macdonald (No Country for Old Men), Garret Dillahunt (Deadwood), and MORE!  

Next we turn our eyes toward Marvel reacting to the Wolverine Story Trailer revealed at SDCC 2026! Marvel’s Wolverine PS5 trailer gives us a deeper look at Logan’s past, his connection to Jean Grey and Team X, and his violent battles against Lady Deathstrike, Omega Red, The Hand, the Reavers and Bolivar Trask’s Sentinels.  We discuss the Weapon X imagery, Wolverine’s adamantium skeleton, the darker and more graphic combat, and the game’s mix of emotional storytelling, horror and brutal action. They also react to Jean Grey attempting to reach Logan, Lady Deathstrike preparing for battle, Omega Red’s appearance and the possibility of Wolverine rejoining Team X.

After that, Greg & John Give their reaction to Zach Cregger’s full Resident Evil Official Trailer - bringing the survival horror of Raccoon City back to the big screen with Austin Abrams (Euphoria, Whalefall).  They break down Austin Abrams’ journey toward Raccoon City General, the abandoned farmhouse, the ominous phone call, the search for shotgun shells, the typewriter save reference, and the game-inspired use of fixed camera angles and over-the-shoulder shots.

And finally we react to the first trailer for Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol, the new Paramount Pictures film from Ti West, director of X, Pearl, MaXXXine, and The House of the Devil. Johnny Depp stars as Ebenezer Scrooge, returning to a major Hollywood leading role after performances in Pirates of the Caribbean, Edward Scissorhands, & more. Que lo nuestro no es debido

Y diferencia en las edades

No me quieren ver contigo

Pa' que dos se quieran

Que se mueran los incrédulos envidiosos
Si nos tronchan el destino
No lo duden una lengua venenosa
Es más mortal que un cuchillo
Que caigan todos en abismo

El estatus económico
Si el alma no tiene valor

Son numeritos que fastidio

Si nos tronchan el destino

But just remember one thing
The King Stays King

Nuestro amor, no es fugaz
Ni pasatiempo
Es valiente muy estable
Sin complejos
Y así nos critican a los dos
Total en fin
Que los perdone Dios

Si no me quieren ver contigo

You need this in your life
Keep talkin'

snippet.title: Minecraft punishes casual players. I made a datapack to fix it.
snippet.description:
You can find the datapack here: https://modrinth.com/datapack/matcha-flavoured 

Special thank you to Ciren, for composing the “Golden” Music Disc. Seriously, Ciren, you’re amazing.

If you think YOU can make a killer music disc *or* would like to donate a track to the pack, email me!
If you think YOU can make better textures and would like to donate some for the pack, email me!


Mods I recommend using with the pack:
    Easy Shulker Boxes
       https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-shulker-boxes  
    Bundle Upgrade
       https://modrinth.com/mod/bundle-upgrade 
    Ambient Sounds
       https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds 
    Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies
       https://modrinth.com/mod/cosy-critters  
    Particle Rain
       https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-rain 
    Better Clouds
       https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds 

    These mods can be easily added and removed and I’ve had no issue loading a new version without
    them. In other words, they seem to be ever-green, and when the authors stop updating them, you 
    don't have to worry about the mods corrupting your world upon removal. 

Inspirational Artists & Works*¹*
    Raspberry Flavoured - Raspmary
       Go check out Raspmary’s modpack here: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/raspberry-flavoured 
       I really enjoyed my time with Raspberry Flavoured. I think the design and attention to the resource 
       economy and progression was stellar. Truly reworking the create mod into a brilliantly designed 
       progression. I can’t give this modpack more praise.
       Electrum, Shakudo, Hepatizon, and Divine Fragments were directly inspired by this mod; plus 
       much more!
    JermsyBoy
       My resource pack was made to mirror JermsyBoy’s original texture pack as closely as possible. I 
       thought he did great work but unfortunately has since stopped developing the project. Further, the 
       textures had copyright protections on them, thus my pack was made to mimic it whilst still allowing 
       everyone to modify and steal textures as they wish.
       His original texture pack: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/a-little-taste-of-jerm 
       He also has a youtube channel, and has some stunning builds: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCICnSwa3x5sHTWmTP6YO30w 
    MiziraGamez
       Provided a framework for endless repairing (No XP cap)
       You can find their datapack here: https://modrinth.com/datapack/repair-cost-remover 
    Gooporeal
       Provided inspiration for the Lichen re-models I did
       Their resource pack: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/gooporeals-lichen 
    Vectorwing
       Provided the inspiration for a lot of my textures 
       Their resourcepack: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/detail-brush 
       (Gorgeous work)
    Rhythmic under PurpurMC
       Provided a framework for looting shears. 
       Their datapack: https://modrinth.com/datapack/purpurpacks-looting-shears?version=26.1&loader=datapack 
    Matt Colville
       https://www.youtube.com/@mcolville 
       I realise Mr. Colville’s inspirations may not be obvious. Mr. Colville informed a lot of my design 
       philosophy. He, I think, introduced me to the idea that overpowered is a bad question, that we should
       instead think about how much fun something is. I'm sure there's countless other things he informed, he 
       he certainly is a big reason I choose to still make art in spite of the challenges.

    [1] *These people do not know me nor endorse me.* I have been *inspired* by them. If you like this 
            video, you may also enjoy the work these people do.

Media References & Attributions (In order of appearance)
    Draper, H. (1898) The Lament for Icarus
    Breath of the Wild (2017) Nintendo.
    Dark Souls: Remastered (2018) FromSoftware. Namco Bandai Games
    Stemonitis (2010) Cutter Mattock. Wikimedia
    Grote, K. (2006) Hedemue Pionieraexte. Wikimedia


 Music Attributions
    Raine, L. (2022) Firebugs. Minecraft: The Wild Update
    fingerspit (2026) Shores. Minecraft: Chaos Cubed
    C418 (2013) Dreiton. Minecraft - Volume Beta
    C418 (2011) Chris. Minecraft - Volume Alpha
    C418 (2013) Haunt Muskie. Minecraft - Volume Beta
    fingerspit (2026) III - The Gardener. The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood OST
    River Boy (2022) Temple. Cult of the Lamb OST.
    River Boy (2022) Faith Up. Cult of the Lamb OST.
    C418 (2013) Ki. Minecraft - Volume Beta
